decode: Per-joint keyframe curves. Rotation: Euler degrees in file order (t0,t1,t2), R = Ry(t0)*Rx(t1)*Rz(t2), angles = i16 * 180/32768. Position: mm, absolute, Y-up. Scale: unitless, near 1.0. Keyframes every 2nd frame (step flag 8192) or every frame (step flag 0); keyframe k is at frame k*step. Convention determined up to a global axis relabeling; see DW-DECODE-LOG.md keyframe section for the validation.
